QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] City Underground, Under Siege
QuestInfo.0: Take the #bDimensional Mirror Portal#k to the #bAzwan Obelisk#k and talk to Knight Gardin of the Cygnus Knights.
QuestInfo.1: Gardin tracked Hilla, the Commander of the Black Mage's Army, here. Below the huge Obelisk, he found Hilla's stronghold, the #bUnderground City of Azwan#k. #bGo inside the Obelisk#k.
QuestInfo.2: You'd heard there were no people here, but there sure are a lot of ghosts. And many of them seem to be high ranking. Is that... a king?!

0.0: The Cygnus Knights were shaken to the core recently. I won't go into the details, but I'm sure it was because of Hilla, the Commander of the Black Mage's Army.
0.1: #rHilla#k... She may be beautiful, but she's a necromancer. She deals with the bodies and souls of the dead. We couldn't just let her run around unchecked, so the knights tracked her here.
0.2: We found this Obelisk... It's conspicuously huge to be in the middle of this barren desert. That's when we discovered the #bUnderground City of Azwan#k right below it. It's awash in Hilla's dark energies.
0.3: Hilla's set herself up here and she's got a strong foothold. We've sent a lot of people in to battle against her armies, but they just haven't found her. The place is covered in the undead.
0.4: Hilla's different from the other Commanders. Where they operate secretly in small numbers, she's amassed a huge army of undead. How do you fight an army that never runs out of soldiers? It's only a matter of time before she wins at this rate.
0.5: With your help, we might be able to turn the tides. What do you say? Will you stand beside the Cygnus Knights and fight in the name of Maple World.

yes.0: Good. You're going to want to get acquainted with the situation. #rThere is no one alive#k in the city of Azwan, but #beven the dead can tell stories there#k. Good luck.
yes.1: Enter the Obelisk and check out #bAzwan#k for yourself.

no.0: You're one of those creeps who doesn't trust the Empress yet, aren't you?

npc.0: I wouldn't have even asked you if I didn't think you could make it through the #rwar#k.
